matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the contradictory definition of threshold γ between Section 3.3 (filtering logic) and Appendix C.2 (experimental interpretation). None of the findings identify this specific inconsistency about γ's filtering behavior. Pred_5 mentions γ but only flags its use in Eq. 10 for edge addition, not the filtering contradiction.

Pred_2 detects exactly this defect, noting that the formula 'sums reciprocal ranks over retrieved features x in F(h_q, C), but RRF should sum, for each candidate, over retrieval channels/lists.'
